name: team stat follows a mid-season trade week by week (executed-result parity)
description: Seed one player on ZTA for 2023 REG weeks 1 and 2 and on ZTB for week 3, with ZTA ALSO playing in week 3, and request team_pass_yards_from_plays under a year+week row axis. Each week's cell must carry the team he was on that week: 10, 20, 77. The fixture is built to distinguish all three attribution mechanisms rather than merely to fail on one. The year-grain majority rule picks ZTA (2 weeks against 1) and renders ZTA's week-3 value of 30 -- a wrong NUMBER, not an empty cell, which is the production form of this defect because the majority team usually plays that week too. team_attribution 'current' picks the player's current_nfl_team, ZTB, and renders NULL for weeks 1 and 2 where ZTB has no seeded game. Only per-week attribution off the gamelogs renders all three cells right. The oracle values are the seeded pass_yards summed per team-week, derived from the seed rather than from output.
